title: Dimglass Coast - Lanterns Along the Tide
_note: Signature first-route theme. gbc 4-voice. 120 BPM, 4/4, G major (relative-major neighbour to Tinderwick C/Am). Lead BOUNCES the Vesper contour - same shape (D->G->A lift ... B->A->G settle) now springy, perky, onward-leaning. Harmony = quick Tide bell-buoy arps chiming offbeats. Bass = steady rocking root-fifth gentle-wave, propulsive. Percussion = light foam-wash: soft kick 1&3, brushy wash hat, small fill at seam. 24-bar ABAC walking form.

tracks.name: lead
tracks._note: Bounced Vesper: D4->G4->A4 lifts on a perky dotted figure, B4->A4->G4 settles. ABAC, hook front-loaded bars 1-2. Last bar lands on D4 (dom) leading back to G downbeat.

tracks._note: Tide bell-buoy arps, broken triads, eighths chiming. G-B-D, C-E-G, D-F#-A, Em(E-G-B) following the bass changes.
